blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) faction chaired by Muslimin Sema has denied that the group is protecting Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague over the deadly war on drugs during the Duterte administration. In a statement entitled “The MNLF is not cuddling (sic) Senator Bato,” the MNLF Information Committee said there is “no established formal relationship” between the senator and the MNLF. The statement was posted on the Facebook page of the Office of the MNLF Chairman Muslimin Sema, former Cotabato City mayor and former Minister […]...
